name: Kanra (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kanra town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kanra, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 18 March 2011; the emblem dates from 22 January 1960.

features.role: Kanra town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a disc
